scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:generate && npm run build:shared && tsc -b apps/server && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:workers && vitest run --project integration
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && node scripts/check-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently --kill-others --names server,web npm:dev:server npm:dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run assets:validate && npm run typecheck && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && npm run build:server:assets && npm run build --workspace @orbit/web
scripts.test:network:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.network.config.ts
scripts.test:timer:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.timer.config.ts
scripts.test:reconnect:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.reconnect.config.ts
scripts.test:lifecycle:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.lifecycle.config.ts
scripts.simulate:bots: npm run build && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.tools.json scripts/simulate-bots.ts
scripts.test:cards:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.cards.config.ts
scripts.test:app:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.app.config.ts
scripts.test:table:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.table.config.ts
scripts.assets:generate: npm run build:shared && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.tools.json scripts/generate-cards.ts
scripts.assets:aux:generate: tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.tools.json scripts/generate-aux-assets.ts && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.tools.json scripts/generate-audio.ts
scripts.test:ui:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.ui.config.ts
scripts.test:replay:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.replay.config.ts
scripts.test:release:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.release.config.ts
